finalText:
Migration's done. I switched 11 files from the old `db.query(sql, params)` call to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, in the support, accounts, billing, analytics, catalog, and orders packages.

One file still calls `db.query`: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. Its own header says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so any change there would just get thrown away. I left it alone.
